d.d: Initialism of endless/eternal/everlasting conscious torment (“traditional view of the nature of Hell”).
The outermost of the three tissue layers in the embryo of a metazoan animal, which produces through development, the epidermis (skin) and nervous system of the adult.
Being out of place; having an abnormal position.
A visible substance believed to emanate from the body of a spiritualistic medium during communication with the dead.
An immaterial or ethereal substance, especially the transparent corporeal presence of a spirit or ghost.
The outer granule-free layer of cytoplasm.
